mapper.sql: SELECT claimNo, activityId, userId, grantAmount, status FROM quota_claim
mapper.select: WHERE activityId = #{activityId} AND userId = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quota_flow (claimNo, flowType, userId, amount) VALUES (#{claimNo}, 'grant', #{userId}, #{grantAmount})
INSERT INTO quota_account (userId, balance) VALUES (#{userId}, #{grantAmount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE balance = balance + #{grantAmount}
mapper.update: UPDATE quota_claim SET status = 'granted', grantedTime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE claimNo = #{claimNo} AND status = 'pending'
